en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel, from Zurara and Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The women do not inherit anything from realty of the land’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Jamil from Zurarah and Muhammad ibn Muslim who has narrated the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Women do not inherit from the real property or land anything.’”
